channel.title: Onchain Brief
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, wallets, security incidents, regulation and new blockchain networks.

item.title: How to Use super bridge From Your Own Wallet
item.description: A wallet-to-wallet bridge moves crypto between chains, but the source network, destination, fees and final confirmation all matter before you send funds.

item.title: Bitcoin falls below $82,000 as liquidations hit $771 million
item.description: Bitcoin fell 2.8% to $81,382 on Monday as $771 million in crypto positions were forcibly closed in 24 hours, most of them bets on rising prices.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates after crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, with $1 million each for six, after the Senate blocked a major crypto market bill.

item.title: Pham Says CFTC Law Already Reaches Most Crypto Markets
item.description: Former CFTC acting chair Caroline Pham says existing US law gives the agency wide reach over crypto, as it weighs rules for leveraged retail trades.

item.title: Sui’s Hashi to launch with more than $500M committed
item.description: Sui says Hashi will start a phased mainnet rollout this month with more than $500 million committed, as Anchorage adds institutional access and liquidity.

item.title: Fairshake names 32 House candidates for crypto election spending
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House incumbents for midterm support, including six slated for $1 million each, as the Senate leaves its crypto market bill stalled.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake will back 32 House candidates, with $1 million each for six, as the crypto market bill remains stalled in the Senate before November's midterms.

item.title: Cardano Foundation spins Veridian out with shares onchain
item.description: Cardano Foundation has made Veridian an independent Swiss company and put most of its one million shares on Cardano, giving CIP-0113 its first equity use.

item.title: Fairshake plans $1M pushes in six House races
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House incumbents for November support, with $1 million in planned spending for six, as the Senate’s crypto market rules bill remains stalled.

item.title: Fairshake names 32 House picks after crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake will back 32 House incumbents, with $6 million set for six races, after Senate lawmakers blocked the crypto market-structure bill in September.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates after Senate bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake plans support for 32 House candidates, six with $1 million each, as Senate failure leaves crypto market rules unresolved before November.

item.title: Chainslist: What to check before adding a treasury network
item.description: Check a treasury network’s chain ID, RPC endpoint and wallet fit before adding it; chainslist connects EVM networks, but setup does not settle custody or control.

item.title: Umia raises $6.11 million in UMIA token auction
item.description: Umia raised $6.11 million by selling 34.6% of its token supply, funding a platform that aims to link projects’ treasuries and governance to their tokens.

item.title: Umia raises $6.11 million in token auction
item.description: Umia raised $6.11 million by selling its own token, setting an $18 million launch valuation as it prepares to offer the same fundraising tools to crypto projects.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake will back 32 House candidates, six with $1 million each, as the Senate’s stalled CLARITY Act leaves crypto rules unresolved before November.

item.title: SEC proposes conditional crypto custody path for advisers and funds
item.description: The SEC has proposed conditional self-custody and state trust company options for crypto held by advisers and funds, with investor safeguards still to come.

item.title: Check the checkout before bridging Polygon funds to Ethereum
item.description: Polygon funds may work at Ethereum NFT checkout without a manual bridge; when they do not, move matching assets across chains and keep ETH for fees.

item.title: How to Set EIP-1559 Fees for a Pending Bridge Transaction
item.description: A pending bridge transaction can often be replaced with a higher-fee transaction using the same nonce; learn how fee caps and tips affect that choice.

item.title: Aztec brings back zk.money for private Ethereum payments
item.description: Aztec Labs has relaunched zk.money on its Aztec Network, giving users private crypto payments while leaving deposit transactions on Ethereum publicly visible.

item.title: How to bridge collateral for market shares on Polygon
item.description: To use collateral for market shares on Polygon, bridge a token the market accepts, check its network and token version, then leave enough POL for fees.
